title: Completed-Stays Figure for Superhost Lookbacks Containing Suspension Days — Host Accounts
content:
# Superhost Programme Rules — Completed-Stays Figure Where the Lookback Includes Suspension Days (Host Accounts)

**Rule.** When the Superhost assessment of an individual Host Accounts holder is decided again, the decision's stays figure is set by the suspension days inside the decided assessment's lookback:

(a) where they number **at least 14**, the stays figure is the larger of the completed stays recorded at the decided assessment and at the assessment before it — the other assessment dated within the 6 months before the decision;

(b) where they number **at least 1 but fewer than 14**, it is the average of the completed stays recorded at those two assessments, rounded down to a whole stay;

(c) where there are none, no such comparison or averaging applies.

**Definitions.** The suspension days inside the decided assessment's lookback are the days counted from the suspended date to the assessment date, and never more than the length of the suspension (its suspended date to the date its account suspension appeal was approved); there are none when the assessment date is not after the suspended date. A window of 6 months holds the records dated fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the date of the decision.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Suspension days inside the lookback | Completed stays at the decided assessment | Completed stays at the assessment before it | Stays figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | 7 | 12 | 12 (the larger) |
| 14 | 11 | 9 | 11 (the larger) |
| 13 | 7 | 12 | 9 (7 and 12 average 9.5, rounded down) |
| 5 | 8 | 9 | 8 (8.5 rounded down) |

Rounding down means the fraction of a stay is dropped: 9.5 becomes 9, never 10.
